Some of my projects.

Academic, professional, and personal design work spanning system design, machine design, facility layout, sheet metal, manufacturing, and CAD.

APSC 200 · Team 23

Mars Centrifuge Greenhouse

Our team proposed a centrifuge greenhouse for Mars that would rotate to create centripetal acceleration and artificial gravity for crop growth.

  • Balanced nutrient density, water, energy, payload/cost, safety, radiation, maintenance, and stakeholder needs.
  • My documented contributions included stakeholder analysis, project planning, creative thinking, project economics, and editing/formatting.
  • Team project — the concept and final proposal were collaborative.
MECH 323 · Team 41

Two-Stage Switching Gearbox

Designed and analyzed a switching gearbox for a model car competing in top-speed and hill-climb events.

  • Balanced torque, weight, packaging, efficiency, fatigue, and durability.
  • Used computational optimization, SOLIDWORKS modeling, gear/shaft force and torque analysis, fatigue analysis, FBDs, and bending moment/torque diagrams.
  • Iteratively refined gearing and structural performance, including AISI 4130 shaft analysis.
Facility Design Proposal

Squash Business Facility Design

Developed a facility design proposal for a squash startup, connecting interior layout and user flow with operational and business considerations.

The design included courts, flooring, changerooms, cafés, circulation, and supporting spaces.

Selected experience.

May 2025 – Apr 2026
Waterloo, Ontario

Mechanical Designer Co-op · Tri-Mach Group

Designed stainless-steel solutions for food and pharmaceutical applications, including chutes, drip/catch pans, conveyors, tables, guarding, transfers, and related equipment.

  • Worked from project kickoff and customer requirements through SOLIDWORKS design and detailed manufacturing drawings.
  • Communicated design intent to millwrights and shop-floor fabrication for laser cutting, routing, welding, machining, and final assembly.
  • Successfully designed and completed 15+ solo projects and contributed design help across 40+ coworker projects.
  • Led spare-parts documentation work, including BOMs and drawings supporting manufacturing, traceability, and maintenance.
  • Performed PDM audits to support metadata accuracy, revision history, and library organization.
Problem solving under a deadlineWhen a sheet-metal VFD mounting plate was laser cut with the wrong hole arrangement and the conveyor was due to ship that day, I designed an adapter plate that reused the existing welded plate’s holes while providing the correct VFD hole pattern. The fix avoided removing the welded plate and kept the project moving.
